input: Get a flu shot before the season starts

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing their country or region determines when flu season typically starts, which sets the deadline for getting the shot.
Whether they have health insurance or a preferred provider affects where they can go and what the cost will be.
Knowing whether they already have a doctor, pharmacy, or clinic in mind determines the immediate next action — booking vs. finding a location.
If this is for multiple family members (e.g., children), the planning steps, locations, and scheduling complexity change significantly.
Some people want only the standard flu vaccine; others want to combine this visit with other vaccines (e.g., COVID booster, TDAP), which affects what to prepare and ask for.
Availability on certain days or times (work schedule, childcare) affects which types of locations — walk-in pharmacy vs. scheduled clinic appointment — are realistic.
Some people just want the shot done; others want a specific vaccine type (e.g., high-dose for seniors, egg-free), which affects which providers to target.

gold.taskTitle: Get a flu shot before season starts
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to get a flu shot proactively before flu season begins, and needs a plan to make that happen.

questions.title: What country or city are you located in?
questions.description: The user's location determines when flu season typically peaks and therefore the ideal timing window for getting vaccinated.

questions.title: Do you have health insurance that covers vaccines?
questions.description: Insurance status affects which providers are in-network and whether there will be any out-of-pocket cost.

questions.title: Do you already have a clinic, pharmacy, or doctor in mind?
questions.description: Having a preferred location in mind changes the next step from 'find a place' to 'book an appointment.'

questions.title: Is this just for you, or for family members too?
questions.description: If children or other family members also need flu shots, scheduling and location requirements become more complex.

questions.title: Do you want to combine this with any other vaccines?
questions.description: Pairing with other boosters (e.g., COVID, TDAP) affects what to request and what providers can administer in one visit.

questions.title: Are there days or times you are unavailable for an appointment?
questions.description: Scheduling constraints determine whether a walk-in pharmacy or a pre-booked clinic appointment is the more realistic path.

questions.title: Do you need a specific flu vaccine formulation?
questions.description: Certain groups (seniors, egg-allergy sufferers) require specific formulations like high-dose or recombinant vaccines, which not all providers stock.
